payload.leagueSummary: NET is still a knife fight, but the cleanest edge belongs to the guys who can actually move the ball and keep the card from catching fire. KeithK75 and Dan94 are the loudest gross monsters, while CRANK keeps sneaking net wins by surviving on short game and a prayer after the tee ball goes feral. The bottom half is a sad little demolition derby: several players are bleeding strokes in multiple places, and the main difference between them is whether the putting merely hurts or actively commits crimes.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 and Dan94 are the real alpha combo in this window: both have the gross stuff, and KeithK75 has the best total package while Dan94 owns the loudest tee ball and the best tee-to-green number.
CRANK is the weird one—bad off the tee, mediocre everywhere else, somehow still cashing net checks because the short game and putting keep dragging him back from the ditch.

BigTime, DREADFUL, and IUDoc92 are all getting cooked in different ways, but the common theme is the same: too many doubles, too many three-putts, and not enough recovery golf to bail out the carnage.
